review_comments: Are you able to reproduce such error that needs mbedtls check? Is so, can you check whether `body_len > 0` before calling `mbedtls_md_update`? Perhaps the error is related to it?

> Are you able to reproduce such error that needs mbedtls check?

I actually have never encounter such error before.

> Perhaps the error is related to it?

It is just that the coverity check is complaining that the return value of `mbedtls_md_update` isn't checked. Maybe casting the function to `void` can fix the complaint as well, but I think printing the error code isn't a bad idea either, in case somebody does indeed encounter some error.
